entities.name: EPS bearer context status
entities.description: Information element used by the UE to indicate which EPS bearer contexts are active within the UE.

entities.name: User Equipment
entities.description: The mobile device that includes the EPS bearer context status IE to indicate active bearer contexts.

entities.name: UE wants to indicate active EPS bearer contexts
entities.description: Condition where the UE includes the EPS bearer context status IE to signal which bearer contexts are active.

relations.description: UE includes the EPS bearer context status IE when it wants to indicate active bearer contexts.
Presence of the EPS bearer context status IE is conditional on the UE wanting to indicate active bearer contexts.
